description:
## Purpose
Umbrella for one feature branch and one pull request delivering three related fixes to the local development loop (owner decision 2026-11-22, choice dialog: dev-loop items on one feature branch with one PR; a change to the batch/preflight loop cannot certify itself through a batch):
- preflight-misses-ci-lint-guards-20261122
- batch-member-check-refusal-message-20261122
- windows-antipatterns-check-scans-worktree-venv-20261028

## Change
Implement the three items on branch `feat/dev-loop-local-gates`, one PR to develop. Each item's own Change, Decision gates, Verification rubric and Guardrails bind.

## Decision gates
- Preflight may grow by at most 60 s (owner, 2026-11-22: "Up to 60 s more"); measure before/after and stop and report above that.
- No CI check is weakened or skipped.

## Verification rubric
Each member item's rubric met; `make pr-preflight` exits 0; before/after preflight timing in the PR.

## Guardrails
Serial feature-branch mode per docs/agent/batch-feature-delivery.md. Edit tool only; no `--no-verify`, force-push, stand-in review or author rewrite; arm once, twice only after fixing a named cause.
